instruction: Delete all .pdf files from my file system ~/downloads folder.
notes: Single-app task (file_system). Flow: get passwords, log in, list ~/downloads (non-recursive, substring filter ".pdf"), delete each file whose path ends with .pdf, then complete the task with no answer. The number of .pdf files is only known at runtime; the problem instantiates two placeholder file objects (matching the 6-call reference solution); if the listing reveals more pdf files, add one file object per pdf (with in-directory/is-pdf init facts and a goal/complete-task conjunct each). Listing a directory makes all its files known (listed ?d) since quantified effects are not allowed. Only files with a true .pdf extension (not just containing the substring) may be deleted; non-pdf files must remain untouched, which is enforced by the is-pdf precondition. supervisor-complete-task takes the deleted file records as non-API parameters so its precondition mirrors the goal.
